The '''Tyne's Horky system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Teraab sector/Legends|Teraab sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC" /> that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tyne's Horky]].<ref name="The Revenge of Kybo Ren" />

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Tyne's Horky system was established in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a reference book written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]] and published in [[2009]], which placed the system in grid square Q-11.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
